headline: Nashua emergency planning group reviewed victim support, recovery resources, and lessons from past incidents.
summary: The Local Emergency Planning Committee heard presentations from the NH Department of Justice and American Red Cross on victim compensation and recovery services. Nashua OEM reviewed citywide coordination lessons from the Sky Meadow shooting, Ash Street fire, and Greater Nashua Mental Health gas explosion. The group identified future priorities including testing the donations management plan, developing an economic recovery plan, and strengthening victim support services.
